messages:
linda: quick sync  how granular should SDK retries be for list/iterate endpoints? paging, streaming, and single-call semantics are all involved.
akash: my take: 3 layers: call-level (unary), page-level (cursor/offset pages), and chunk-level (streamed frames). map SDK semantics to those.
tom: big caveat: offset-based paging + page-level retries will duplicate unless server dedupes. we should recommend cursor/resume tokens in API design review.
riley: agreed. practically, SDKs should default: unary -> call-level retry, cursor pages -> page-level retry, streaming -> no automatic chunk retry (use reconnect+resume).
linda: ergonomics: TS/py want a per-call opts param; Go wants client options + functional WithRetry per-call. acceptable to vary.
akash: propose a small surface in the runtime: RetryContext = { scope: "call" | "page" | "stream-chunk", retryable: bool, allowReorder: bool }. transports implement mapping to rpc layer.
tom: we also need a generator flag so codegen can mark RPCs: x-sdk-retry-scope: page/call/none, and x-sdk-pagination-type: cursor|offset|none. default decisions flow from that.
riley: sample usage sketches:
TS:
```ts
// per-call override
client.listRecords({ pageSize: 200 }, { retry: { maxAttempts: 2, scope: 'page' } })
```
Go:
```go
// client-level default, per-call override
c := NewClient(WithRetry(Policy{Max:3, Scope: Call}))
c.ListRecords(ctx, &ListOpts{PageSize:200}, WithRetry(Policy{Max:2, Scope: Page}))
```
Python:
```py
# per-call opts
client.list_records(page_size=200, retry=Retry(max_attempts=2, scope='page'))
```
linda: those examples look readable. note name collisions: prefer 'retry_scope' in public param to avoid confusion with other scope uses.
akash: we should also ship a high-level iterator helper in all SDKs: iterate_all(deduplicate=True) that uses resume tokens under the hood and dedups if pagination type is cursor. For offset-style, warn in docs.
tom: telemetry: tag metrics/retries with retry_scope and retry_trigger (retryable_error, transient_net). Console can surface cost breakdowns by scope.
riley: streaming nuance: if stream supports resume-token then allow reconnect/resume at chunk boundaries; do not retry individual chunks. default maxAttempts for stream-chunk=1.
linda: edge case: server-side partial updates causing inconsistent pages. recommend API owners prefer immutable cursors or include stable item ids so SDK dedupe can work.
akash: decision list to put in RFC: 1) add codegen annotations x-sdk-retry-scope & x-sdk-pagination-type; 2) implement RetryContext shim in transport; 3) conservative language defaults + per-call overrides; 4) provide iterate_all helper with dedupe; 5) add telemetry tags.
tom: no blockers from infra. I'll add tests around offset vs cursor behaviors.
riley: I'll draft the doc and examples for devex.
infra-bot: ACTION: RFC draft assigned to riley, tests to tom, iterate_all implementation to akash. Due in one week. (link: https://rfc.internal/456) :white_check_mark:
